t: Minimum Operations to Make Elements Within K Subarrays Equal
o: Choose k disjoint windows of length x; within each window pay the sum of absolute deviations to the window's median (the minimum cost to equalize it). Minimize the total. Costs of all sliding windows can be maintained in O(log n) per slide with two Fenwick trees over compressed values (counts and sums): the median is the positional (x+1)/2-th smallest, and cost = median*leftCount - leftSum + rightSum - median*rightCount. Then a knapsack-style DP over window start positions with at most k = 15 picks finishes the job: dp[j][i] = min(dp[j][i-1], dp[j-1][i-x] + cost[i]). Example 1 picks windows [1..3] and [5..7] with median costs 5 and 3.
k: Equalizing a window optimally targets the median; cost = sum |a_i - median|, obtainable in O(log n) per slide via count/sum Fenwick trees.
Windows must be disjoint, so DP over start positions with jumps of exactly x.
k <= 15 keeps the DP layer count tiny.

a.n: Approach 1: Sliding-window median cost + layered DP
a.i: Precompute cost[s] for every window start s using a Fenwick-indexed multiset supporting k-th order statistic and prefix sums. Then run dp layers j = 1..k over starts, each layer a linear scan combining 'skip this start' with 'take window at s' from layer j-1 at s-x.
s: Coordinate-compress values; build two BITs (count, sum).
Slide the window across all starts, recording the median-abs-deviation cost of each.
DP: dp[j][s] = min(dp[j][s-1], dp[j-1][s-x] + cost[s]); answer dp[k][last].
a.t: O(n log n) — one Fenwick update/query triple per slide plus an O(nk) DP
a.sp: O(n) for BITs and DP layers

w: Two facts carry the solution: the median minimizes sum of absolute deviations, and disjoint windows over a line admit a simple interval-scheduling DP. Careful with even x (either middle element gives the same cost) and with 64-bit sums (values up to 1e6 times window size). Follow-up: if windows could overlap you would need a different formulation entirely; if k were large, the DP's concavity could be exploited with Lagrangian relaxation (Aliens trick).
